notes.title: Power Champions Patch Update 1.2.5.5
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Patch 1.2.5.5![/h1]

We're excited to announce some major updates to Power Champions. First and foremost, we've reduced the overall price from $4.99 to $2.99!

Here's what you can expect in this update:

[list]
[*] Quality of life improvements in the interface, with a wider variety of colors and designs for easier and more practical gameplay.
[*] Bug fixes in the World map and dialogue.
[*] Spelling corrections in various scenes.
[*] Changes to default settings, such as cell shading and outlines.
[*] Added item descriptions in the character selection screen.
[*] Introduction of an item that boosts damage, defense, and speed at the normal level, but becomes disabled after defeating the boss (both in the farming and boss maps).
[*] Text dialogue additions to certain NPCs to enhance immersion.
[*] Incorporation of new sounds, like character footsteps, and various sound improvements.
[*] Adjustment of character running animations to match assigned speed.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these enhancements and continue to have a fantastic experience in Power Champions!

notes.title: Power Champions - Launching on 10/10/2023!
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 Power Champions - Launching on 10/10/2023! Get Ready for Epic Action! 🚀[/h1]

We are thrilled to announce that Power Champions, our exciting hack-and-slash RPG game, will be launching tomorrow, on October 10, 2023! Get ready for an unforgettable journey filled with epic battles, unique powers, and a captivating storyline.

[h3][b]Brief Story Summary:[/b][/h3]
In the world of Zarion, you are the chosen Champion to confront terrifying mechanical threats. Battle relentless enemies, empower yourself with mystical artifacts, and embark on a mission to restore peace to your realm. The Goddess Ellora sacrificed herself to create this universe, and now it's up to you to protect it.

[h3][b]Upcoming Updates:[/b][/h3]
We want to ensure that your journey in Power Champions is always thrilling. We are committed to providing regular updates that will include:

✨ [b]New Maps[/b]: Explore intriguing new locations on Zarion and other planets, filled with challenges and secrets to uncover.

💥 [b]New Powers[/b]: Unlock even more incredible abilities as you progress, expanding your combat repertoire.

🌟 [b]New Characters[/b]: Meet new allies and adversaries that will deepen the story and gameplay.

🎮 [b]New Game Modes[/b]: Experience new ways to play, testing your skills and strategies.

We appreciate you joining us on this journey thus far and hope you'll enjoy Power Champions as much as we enjoyed creating it.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates, and in the meantime, get ready for action!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414580/Power_Champions/]Link to Power Champions on Steam[/url]

Let the battle begin! 🗡️🛡️
